subject: Otyugh
picture: An otyugh in a dungeon refuse room. Draw these parts only: 1 bloated oval body, 3 thick elephant legs, 2 long side tentacles that end in leaf-shaped spiked pads, 1 vine stalk on top that holds both eyes together, 1 wide gash-mouth on the front of the body. No extra eye on the body. No tentacle coming out of the mouth. Sacks and bones on the floor. Stone ceiling, walls, closed door. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02. All-ages.
